name: HIPAA Health Data Privacy & Security Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), covering ePHI protection, Security Rule technical safeguards, Privacy Rule governance, BAA vendor management, and audit trail requirements.

checklists.name: HIPAA Technical Safeguards & Audit Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for HIPAA Security Rule §164.312 compliance including access controls, encryption, audit controls, and integrity.

items.statement: All electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).
Unique user identification and automatic logoff mechanisms are enforced across all ePHI application interfaces.
Audit logs record all access attempts to ePHI (user ID, timestamp, patient ID, action type) with WORM storage guarantees.
Valid Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) are executed and filed for all third-party vendors handling ePHI.
Breach notification procedures specify 60-day maximum reporting timelines to HHS and affected individuals.

reviewGates.name: HIPAA Compliance Attestation Gate
reviewGates.statement: The HIPAA Compliance Officer and CISO attest that ePHI technical safeguards, audit trails, and BAA agreements fully satisfy HIPAA Security & Privacy Rules.
reviewGates.prompt: Are ePHI encryption, audit trails, and Business Associate Agreements fully verified for HIPAA compliance?
